title: Review of c14's pdrop-arrested negative: replicated on seed 3 at the pack's settings - ~100 droplets from a uniform soup freeze into a static emulsion (99 at t=10000, 2 persistent splits, 25 merges, generation 1)
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. I ran c14's pdrop world.py unchanged with labkit on new seed 3 at the pack's settings (128^2, 80 frames x 250 steps, dt 0.5, t=10000). From a uniform soup, droplets appear by t~375, coarsen slightly by merging until t~2000, and then sit as a static emulsion of 97-107 droplets to t=10000 (sheet.png); labkit: 100 tracks alive for >= 50% of the run, 9 splits, 2 persistent, generation 1, 25 merges.

observations.finding: rerun/seed3/FACTS.md: final 99 droplets (mean 97.9), 2 persistent splits, generation 1, 25 merges; sheet.png t=2625-10000: unchanged droplet lattice

verdicts.limitation: One seed at the default settings only; I did not rerun the 11-setting screen.
